title: The ticket-sentence to test pairing behind the Tests tab
description: Written by scripts/semcov.py (the scripted pass, every link with its evidence — a candidate, not proof) and by a cheap model through scripts/rerun-model.py into .human-review/test-mapping.json: the model is asked about every sentence that makes a claim, confirms or rejects each link the script made (`review`), and may mark a sentence `narrowed` when a scope decision the branch recorded narrows it (`decision`). The build merges the two and draws the matrix; a sentence the model has not answered shows its scripted links as unconfirmed, never as covered. A model answer names only the sentences it was asked about, only test ids from the list it was given, and only decision ids it was shown.

review.description: One verdict per link the script made for this sentence: confirm (it stays in `tests`) or reject (it does not).

decision.description: `narrowed` only: the id of the recorded decision that narrows the sentence.
